subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should this PR expose blocked Telegram/WhatsApp DM content to trusted pre-auth hooks and make grouped DM allowlist config part of the channel/plugin contract?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it changes a security-sensitive pre-admission boundary and public/plugin configuration contracts that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Approve bounded pre-auth contract
options.body: Accept the new hook and grouped allowlist API after owner review confirms trusted-hook exposure, redaction expectations, and upgrade behavior are intentional.

options.title: Narrow to internal access requests
options.body: Keep the user workflow but remove or privatize the plugin-facing pre-auth API and grouped config contract until the surface is formally designed.

options.title: Defer to shared audit design
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of a channel-agnostic denied-inbound audit surface covering Telegram groups, WhatsApp denials, retention, rate limiting, and notification policy.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded pre-auth contract
recommendation.body: Accept the new hook and grouped allowlist API after owner review confirms trusted-hook exposure, redaction expectations, and upgrade behavior are intentional.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest sampled recent history across hook contracts, allowlist command/config helpers, and channel/plugin boundaries touched by the decision.
